findings.summary: Fixed: identity-free uuid/uuid image paths via reserve_kudos_image_path; ownership in client-inaccessible kudos_image_uploads; anonymous-images e2e proves it
Fixed: profiles.auth_user_id revoked via explicit column re-grant; viewer_profile definer view serves owner only
Fixed: p_content capped at 50000 and image URLs at 500 chars in the RPC
Fixed: submit while uploading now surfaces compose.errors.imageUploading
Fixed: class no longer allowed on mention spans
ROLLBACK header comment is garbled (interleaved lines from two edits); rewrite as ordered runnable steps
Reserve rate limit is count-then-insert (concurrent calls can exceed 25); no send_kudos rate limit or orphan sweep; accepted risk
Registry proves reservation, not that the object was uploaded; dangling URLs render broken images. Optionally check storage.objects
